background_assets.name: Background Assets
background_assets.usage_note: If you want some direction for your starting paths, roll or pick from the table below and take the two paths associated with your selected background.

backstory_prompts.name: Backstory Prompts
backstory_prompts.usage_note: For some backstory inspiration, roll or pick from the table below. Then, take a moment to elaborate on the suggestion. Or just leave it a bit vague and mysterious for now; you can flesh it out in play.

starship_history.usage_note: Envision how you obtained or earned this ship. You can come up with your own origin, or roll or pick from the table below. If you use a result from the table, take a moment to consider and elaborate on the suggestion.

name_given.name: Character Name — Given Name
name_given.usage_note: Given and family names are presented as a pair; roll once for both, twice to mix-and-match, or use independently. Can also be reversed.

name_callsign.name: Character Name — Callsign
name_callsign.usage_note: Spacers are often known only by their callsigns, with their "dirtside names" reserved for family and close friends.

revealed_aspect.name: Revealed Character Aspect
revealed_aspect.usage_note: As you interact with a person to gain deeper understanding, roll to reveal new characteristics. Recommended: roll 1-3 times.

action.name: Action
action.usage_note: When you Ask the Oracle about a goal, situation, or event, roll for an Action and Theme. Together, these provide an interpretative verb/noun prompt.

theme.name: Theme
theme.usage_note: When you Ask the Oracle about a goal, situation, or event, roll for an Action and Theme. Together, these provide an interpretative verb/noun prompt.

descriptor.name: Descriptor
descriptor.usage_note: When you Ask the Oracle to help define the nature of a location, discovery, or encounter, roll for a Descriptor and a Focus for an adjective/noun prompt.

focus.name: Focus
focus.usage_note: When you Ask the Oracle to help define the nature of a location, discovery, or encounter, roll for a Descriptor and a Focus for an adjective/noun prompt.

environment.name: Environment
environment.usage_note: Choose the closest match for your location, or roll to identify the primary habitat of a creature. Each result links to a matching Basic Form table.

ultra_scale.name: Ultra-scale
ultra_scale.usage_note: Roll only when Scale results in Ultra-scale.

creatures_first_look.name: Creature First Look
creatures_first_look.usage_note: Roll for a Basic Form, then flesh out the creature's appearance using this table. Recommended: roll 1-2 times.

encountered_behavior.name: Encountered Behavior
encountered_behavior.usage_note: Frames this creature's motivation and how the encounter begins.

creatures_revealed_aspect.name: Revealed Creature Aspect
creatures_revealed_aspect.usage_note: Roll while interacting with the creature to introduce new features or behaviors. Some results may contradict the creature's established nature -- feel free to ignore, reroll, or adjust. Recommended: roll 1-2 times.

basic_form_space.name: Basic Form — Space
basic_form_space.usage_note: Roll only after Environment determines Space.

basic_form_interior.name: Basic Form — Interior
basic_form_interior.usage_note: Roll only after Environment determines Interior.

basic_form_land.name: Basic Form — Land
basic_form_land.usage_note: Roll only after Environment determines Land.

basic_form_liquid.name: Basic Form — Liquid
basic_form_liquid.usage_note: Roll only after Environment determines Liquid.

basic_form_air.name: Basic Form — Air
basic_form_air.usage_note: Roll only after Environment determines Air.

access_area.name: Access — Area
access_area.usage_note: Roll to envision the spaces you encounter in this zone. Can serve as a waypoint if you Undertake an Expedition.

access_feature.name: Access — Feature
access_feature.usage_note: Roll sparingly to reveal new aspects of your surroundings.

access_peril.name: Access — Peril
access_peril.usage_note: Roll for a complication or danger within this zone.

entries.result: Dreadful scene of death or violence

access_opportunity.name: Access — Opportunity
access_opportunity.usage_note: Roll for a beneficial encounter or event, such as a strong hit with a match on Undertake an Expedition.

theme.usage_note: Roll when you need a subject or theme to pair with an Action result, or to inspire a narrative element on its own.
